---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool or an improvement to an existing one
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Is this a new tool, or a change to an existing one?**

**What problem does this solve?**
What are you trying to do that Snaply doesn't currently support?

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see. For a new tool, note whether it can run entirely
client-side (Canvas/WebAssembly/File API) — see the privacy invariant in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#design-principles). Snaply can't accept
a tool that requires uploading user images to a server.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.
